description: Balanced: takes points when they are there, keeps an eye on what the opponent is collecting.

opponent_is_close.instructions: From `opponent.discarded` (oldest first), `opponent.took_from_discard` and `stock.drawn_so_far`, how close is the opponent to being able to knock?
criteria: Far from knocking: still throwing high cards, with no melds evident.
Building melds, but likely still holding a lot of deadwood.
Could plausibly knock within the next two or three turns.
Able to knock now or on the next turn.

opponent_wants.instructions: Which slot of `candidates` is the opponent most likely to meld, judged from `opponent.discarded` and `opponent.took_from_discard`? Answer with the slot number.

criteria.0: The card in `candidates[0]`, at the cost `candidates[0].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.1: The card in `candidates[1]`, at the cost `candidates[1].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.2: The card in `candidates[2]`, at the cost `candidates[2].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.3: The card in `candidates[3]`, at the cost `candidates[3].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.4: The card in `candidates[4]`, at the cost `candidates[4].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.5: The card in `candidates[5]`, at the cost `candidates[5].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.6: The card in `candidates[6]`, at the cost `candidates[6].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.7: The card in `candidates[7]`, at the cost `candidates[7].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.8: The card in `candidates[8]`, at the cost `candidates[8].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.9: The card in `candidates[9]`, at the cost `candidates[9].deadwood_after` leaves me.
criteria.10: The card in `candidates[10]`, at the cost `candidates[10].deadwood_after` leaves me.

move.instructions: It is my turn. Which move should I make? Weigh `me.deadwood` and what each option costs me against what `read` says the opponent is doing.

criteria.take_upcard: Take `upcard` into my hand: worth it when it joins one of `me.melds` or clearly cuts `me.deadwood`.
criteria.draw_stock: Draw the unknown top of `stock`: the ordinary move when `upcard` does not help.
criteria.discard: Throw this card and play on - the balanced choice when `read.opponent_is_close` leaves me room to improve.
criteria.knock: End the hand now and take the points, which is right once I can and `read.opponent_is_close` says waiting is a gamble.
criteria.gin: Go gin: every card melded, nothing left over.
